title: MyClusterView
description: Federated view of all devices belonging to a single agent (the viewer). Source of truth: peer_identity_bindings filtered by agent_cid (Category A from imagodei DHT), federated across household peers via the view-slice aggregator (Operational, Category C). Reconstructed per request; not persisted.

agentCid.description: Agent CID this cluster view is scoped to.

devices.description: Per-device summary rows, one per registered AgentPeerBinding for this agent.

externalCommittedBytes.description: Bytes committed to peers outside this agent's cluster.

reciprocityNetBytes.description: Net reciprocation bytes across this agent's devices (signed).

totals.description: Aggregated totals across all devices in the cluster.

freshness.description: Overall cluster freshness — worst-of-devices when any device is offline, live when all live.
